description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the PimCsvDataImportService. It contains multiple test cases for importing CSV data, testing validation, duplicate detection, and integration with other services in the context of employee data import in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for the PimCsvDataImportService, testing CSV import functionality, validation rules, duplicate handling, and integration with employee and country services.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Populate test fixtures for Country and Nationality data before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Truncates specific tables and initializes the PimCsvDataImportService instance.

methods.name: testGetCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Verifies that the service instance returned by getCsvDataImportService() is of type CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: testImport
methods.description: Tests a successful CSV import scenario with valid data.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests import handling when duplicate employee IDs are present.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Verifies behavior when first name and last name fields contain invalid data.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Checks handling of invalid license expiry date formats and values.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidMaritalStatus
methods.description: Tests import validation for marital status field with invalid entries.

methods.name: testImportWithNationality
methods.description: Verifies correct processing of nationality data, including invalid entries.

methods.name: testImportWithContactDetails
methods.description: Tests customer contact details handling during import.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMailForSameEmployee
methods.description: Checks duplicate email handling for contacts within the same employee record.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMail
methods.description: Tests duplicate email across different employees during import.

methods.name: testImportWithoutFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Tests behavior when critical fields like first name and last name are missing or invalid.
